LanguageData.LP_MindResist.label: mind resistance
LanguageData.LP_MindResist.description: Chance to resist mind effects such as psychic blasts, parasites and charm; also proportionally weakens negative psychic moods such as psychic drone. Loss-of-control states forced on our units by vanilla or VPE psycasts (such as fleeing in terror, berserk) are also resisted with this chance; if not resisted, the duration is shortened by the same proportion (up to 75% shorter).
